en:
`{name}` was removed from the catalog. It stays installed, but no longer gets updates.

Uninstall it from its [page in the Marketplace](/marketplace/repository/{repository_id}).

Avinstallera det från dess [sida i Marketplace](/marketplace/repository/{repository_id}).
